command: D=emu/tv-match/real/diag.txt; mkdir -p emu/tv-match/real; { echo "diag $(date -u +%H:%M:%S)"; git rev-parse --show-toplevel; git log --oneline -1; git status --porcelain | head -5; ls emu/tv-match/; } > $D 2>&1; git config user.name cloudpc; git config user.email cloudpc@local; git add $D; git commit -m 'tv-match: diag probe' > emu/tv-match/real/diag-push.txt 2>&1; git fetch origin main >> emu/tv-match/real/diag-push.txt 2>&1; for i in 1 2 3; do git push origin main >> emu/tv-match/real/diag-push.txt 2>&1 && break; git pull --rebase origin main >> emu/tv-match/real/diag-push.txt 2>&1; sleep 5; done; git add emu/tv-match/real/diag-push.txt; git commit -m 'tv-match: diag push transcript' >> emu/tv-match/real/diag-push.txt 2>&1; git push origin main > /dev/null 2>&1; echo DIAG_DONE
